name: @arcane-spark/ubel-node
description: Software supply-chain and source-code security for Node.js. SCA: resolves dependencies, scans via OSV.dev and NVD, and annotates findings with heuristic reachability (SBOM/CycloneDX + SARIF reporting). Firewall: gates npm/pnpm/bun installs behind a lockfile-only dry-run scan before anything reaches node_modules, with atomic revert and TOCTOU protection; also gates pip/uv/pipx installs behind a dry-run resolution (`pip install --dry-run` / `uv pip compile`), and apt/dnf/yum installs (one dedicated binary per package manager) behind each one's own native dry-run, in both cases before anything is actually installed (no lockfile concept there, so no revert/TOCTOU step — a rejected scan simply never runs the real install). Also includes an AI-powered SAST engine (scan → verify → taint-trace) for source-level vulnerability detection, a separate malicious-code/backdoor scanner (both with JSON, HTML, and SARIF reporting), and a cloud misconfiguration scanner for AWS/GCP/Azure — public exposure, IAM, encryption, and audit-logging posture via each provider's own read-only API, with JSON and HTML reporting.
author: Ala Bouali <ala.bouali.1997@gmail.com>
